method: Manual page-by-page visual and extracted-text accounting of a captured public university PDF. Body-free identity leads only; source, identity, trait and rights review remain separate.

sources.title: University of Georgia — blueberries for gardens and landscapes
sources.enumerated_scope: All 38 pages visually checked: three named blueberries, six experimental ornamental selections and two additional handwritten photo labels. Repeated slide headings are counted once per identity; Gold Rush remains paired with TO-1398 for review.
sources.limitations: Historical presentation, not a complete release or licensing register. The URL path includes 2015; no exact publication or release date is inferred. T-959 is not automatically an alias of Titan. Alapaha on both photo cards could be a site or a variety label and is withheld. Source traits, patent assertions, growing locations and image reuse rights remain unverified. This does not close the inaccessible current licensing-list gap.
